source_files.demo-project-with cars.stl: 65,726 tris, ASCII, 37 bodies: 1 CVWT + 2 cars + rig
source_files.demo-project.ply: 161,066 tris, ASCII (zoo.dev), 79 bodies: 3 CVWTs at x = -650/0/+650 mm + 4 vehicles (2 per lane, incl. a larger 402 mm body)

units_and_frame: millimetres; z up; x along lanes; origin on the CVWT axis at base-dish bottom (z=0); road/belt top z = -15 mm

scale_check_vs_locked_interpretation.note: rotor Ø112 mm vs 110 mm median plate: rotor overhangs the median by ~1 mm per side

cvwt_parts.fins: 4 helical fins (passive rotor), r 13.9-56.0 mm, z 75-306.7 mm (231.7 mm span), ~0.75 deg/mm twist (~175 deg total); each closed, manifold
cvwt_parts.hollow_cylinder: OD 24 / ID 20 mm, z 58-306.7 mm, genus 36 -> ~35 radial holes, total open area ~718 mm^2 (mean ~5 mm dia); bore OPEN at the top (caps are rings)
cvwt_parts.caps: 2 rings OD 30 mm, 4 mm thick at z 72-76 and 302.7-306.7 (rotor end plates)
cvwt_parts.housing: base dish Ø150 x 5 mm + housing tube ID 34 / OD 38 mm, z 5-72, annular lid ID 24 at z 70-72
cvwt_parts.filter_placeholder: solid cylinder Ø34 x 18 mm at z 27-45 (fills the housing bore)
cvwt_parts.mount_plates: 170x170x5 and 170x110x10 mm solid blocks under the dish (z -15..0)

flow_path_check.finding: No downward outlet exists: housing floor (z 0-5) and both mount plates are solid on the axis (ray-cast confirmed). The drawn path ends in a dead end.
flow_path_check.cfd_treatment: cvwt_base_stack.stl (build_outlet.py, parametric W/RIB); domain bottom z=-25 mm = patch outletFilter, total pressure 0.
flow_path_check.decision_2026-09-22: User: outlet = slots through the base-dish floor, both mount plates and the median plate, venting to still room air. Slot dimensions not yet specified -> placeholder 3 x 6 mm slots (467 mm2, 51 % of the accepted Ø34 placeholder area).

flow_path_check.finding: Top of the hollow cylinder is open (bore reachable from above the rotor, z = 306.7). This is a second inlet/outlet in parallel with the holes and can bypass the filter.
flow_path_check.cfd_treatment: Both variants in the sweep: 'topOpen' (as modelled) and 'topCapped'. Confirm the design intent.

flow_path_check.finding: Filter is a solid placeholder; 18 mm bed thickness and Ø34 face are the only known filter data.
flow_path_check.cfd_treatment: Meshed as fluid + porous cellZone (Darcy-Forchheimer) with labelled candidate resistances.

flow_path_check.finding: Stationary tube sits inside rotating fins with 1.9 mm radial clearance (r 12 -> 13.9 mm).
flow_path_check.cfd_treatment: Stage 1 = frozen rotor at 4 azimuths; stage 2 needs an AMI/MRF interface inside that gap -> resolve with >= 4 cells across.

flow_path_check.finding: Wheels (512 non-manifold edges each), belts (70) and enclosure (30) are not watertight solids; enclosure ends are open.
flow_path_check.cfd_treatment: Not used in stage 1. Before the moving-vehicle stage: replace wheels with simple cylinders, repair/merge enclosure in CAD.
